name: Alembix
look: a copper pot still on four legs with a domed head, a swan-neck pipe arching back into a coiled cooling tank
entry: It grows a long, gracefully curved swan-neck pipe from its head that coils into a cooling tank on its back. It constantly drips crystal-clear distilled water from its spout, purifying polluted ponds wherever it walks.
how: Evolve Copperpot at level 26. It learns Condense when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
Evolves into Stillforge at level 42 with a Fire-type Pokémon in the party.
